args.summary:
Modeled the 3-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box-girder bridge (30+45+30 m, deck width 12.5 m) as a 2D spine-beam with elastic beam-column elements (MR-01), system "continuous_on_piers" (MR-05) since pier column geometry is given.
